start: Owner signed in online; Import page; a file whose column names are unusual

user_sees: 'Names, addresses, phone numbers, emails and ID numbers are hidden before anything is sent.'
must_not: A button the owner must tap to start the matching
The list of rows hidden while it waits

user_sees: 'AI matched <n> columns. Check the boxes below and change any that are wrong.' or 'AI checked your columns and agrees with them. Check the boxes below.'
The boxes it set carry '· Matched by AI'
must_not: A real name, phone number or ID number sent to the AI
Anything saved before Add is tapped

start: A file is open on the Import page (other ways the matching starts: a new header row, another sheet)

user_sees: The boxes start again from the new row
must_not: The answer for the old header row applied to the new one

steps.action: Pick another sheet in the 'Sheet' box before the answer comes
user_sees: The line is about the new sheet only
must_not: The first sheet's late answer changing the second sheet's boxes

steps.action: Turn the internet off and choose a file
user_sees: In warning colour: 'Matched without AI (it was not available). Check the columns below.'
The boxes filled by the built-in rules

steps.action: Choose a file after today's AI allowance is used up
user_sees: 'Matched without AI (it was not available). Check the columns below.'
must_not: The owner charged or asked to pay

steps.action: Use a gym that is not signed in online
user_sees: 'Matched without AI (it was not available). Check the columns below.'

start: A file is open and the AI is still matching

steps.action: Set the Plan box by hand before the answer comes
user_sees: The Plan box keeps the column the owner picked
must_not: The AI answer replacing the owner's pick

steps.action: After the answer, change a box that says '· Matched by AI'
must_not: The tag staying on a box the owner set

steps.action: Look at 'Other columns in your file'
user_sees: A column the AI found useless is unticked with 'AI says this column is not needed, so it is not kept.'
must_not: A column the owner ticked by hand unticked by the AI

start: Owner online; a file with names, mobiles, addresses and an Aadhaar column

steps.action: Choose the file and read the line under the matching words
user_sees: 'Names, addresses, phone numbers, emails and ID numbers are hidden before anything is sent.'
must_not: Any real name, mobile, address, email or ID number leaving the browser

steps.action: Sign in as the front desk and choose the same file
user_sees: No AI line; the built-in rules fill the boxes
must_not: The front desk's file sent to the AI
